messages:
Samira Khan: Heads up 11 CloudHub wants a synchronous launch: marketplace listing + joint webinar + a short benchmark post in the same week (tight). Can we map owners and the lead handoff?
Ethan Lo: I can take the webinar brief and host. Proposed week: June 7-11; marketplace goes live June 9. Syncs sales motion better.
Priya Desai: OK. Ill write the marketplace listing and the short benchmark blog. Need a 2-line headline + 300 char body and 1 screenshot limit (CloudHub constraint).
Nate Turner: DesignBot, can you produce a 1-sheet + hero image sized for marketplace (1200x628) and a smaller thumbnail?
DesignBot: Request received. ETA: 48h for mockups. I'll include co-brand lockups and alt colorways.
Samira Khan: Required marketing items: webinar brief (Ethan), marketplace copy + benchmark blurb (Priya), co-branded one-pager (Design), lead routing spec (Nate). Legal must approve logos by Wed.
Ethan Lo: Webinar format: 30m content (15m benchmark highlights + 10m product demo + 5m quick customer spot), 20m live Q. Panel: Ethan (host), Priya (benchmarks), Nate (ops/demo), CloudHub PM (customer).
Priya Desai: Benchmarks to spotlight: median token latency at 512 tokens, cost per 1k tokens vs baseline, and a small embedding recall comparison. I'll prepare one chart (png) for the blog.
Nate Turner: Lead routing plan sketch: CloudHub marketplace CTA -> HubSpot form -> HubSpot converts to lead -> HubSpot sync to SFDC Lead (Campaign: CHB_June9) -> If lead_tag contains "webinar_reg" or form field demo=true then assign to "Marketplace SDRs" queue and change status to MQL -> Send Slack webhook to #sales-untriaged.
HubSpotBot: Example webhook payload posted to #automation. {"source":"cloudhub_marketplace","campaign":"chb_june9","lead_score":92} (bot note: payload simulated)
Ethan Lo: Add UTM scheme: utm_source=cloudhub, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=chb_june9, utm_content=variantA|variantB. We'll use utm_content to measure messaging variants.
Priya Desai: Messaging variants: Variant A (performance-first): "Cut infra spend on inference; maintain accuracy." Variant B (developer-first): "Ship LLM features faster with predictable latency." We'll A/B on marketplace short headline and LinkedIn copy.
Samira Khan: Good. Also prepare two short speaker blurbs for the landing page and 3 bullets: what attendees will learn, who should attend, takeaways + CTA.
Nate Turner: Automation detail: hot leads (score>80 or demo=true) -> immediate assign + email and ping to AE via OpsWebhook. Cold leads -> 7-day nurture sequence. Make sure partner_source=cloudhub is set on all leads.
Priya Desai: Note on benchmarking narrative: don't reveal raw model weights or internal configs. Emphasize workload types (chat gen, embeddings) and relative numbers. Legal okayed that approach previously.
DesignBot: Uploaded 3 mockups here: https://drive.redwood/mktg/cloudhub_co_launch/mockups. Includes marketplace hero, thumbnail, and one-pager draft.
Samira Khan: Legal approval needed for CloudHub logo and co-brand copy by Wed EOD. Priya, ping legal and drop files in #legal-review.
Ethan Lo: Recording plan: live demo + pre-recorded fallbacks for demo steps 3-5. Nate, can ops provide a playback clip if live demo fails?
Nate Turner: Yes. We'll record the demo flow and host on CDN. Also provide ephemeral creds and a sanitized dataset.
HubSpotBot: Reminder: Landing page scheduled to publish at 1923460800. Two reminders will be posted automatically (48h and 2h).
Samira Khan: Quick checklist recap: Ethan -> webinar brief + speaker blurbs; Priya -> marketplace copy + blog + benchmark chart; Nate -> lead routing spec + demo recording; Design -> assets + one-pager. Legal -> logo approval. Reconvene Thurs to approve final assets.
Ethan Lo: I'll drop the brief here by EOD Tue.
Priya Desai: Draft blog + two marketplace variants in thread tomorrow AM.
Nate Turner: I'll post the HubSpot field mapping and webhook example in this thread when ready.
Samira Khan: Thanks team 680 let's keep the copy short and measurement-focused. :white_check_mark:
